evidence.text: The article says the earliest securely identifiable 干 in its account is on the mid-Western Zhou 豦簋. It describes the form as a round shield-like body with a forked top; later Western Zhou examples change the round upper feature to a short horizontal stroke, retained in later scripts. The article discusses proposed earlier Shang forms separately.
